name: Xperia Go

images.credit: Blakegripling ph, CC BY-SA 3.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Body.Other: IP67 certified, water-resistant and dust-resistant (up to 1 meter for 30 minutes)

Platform.Operating system: Android 2.3.7 "Gingerbread", 4.0.4 "Ice Cream Sandwich, Upgradeable to Android 4.1.2 "Jelly Bean", Unofficial upgrade to Android 4.4.4 ("KitKat") via XDA

Memory.Card slot: Up to 32 GB using microSD cards

Display.Display: 3.5-inch, HVGA (480x320 pixels) (165 ppi), 16,777,216 colour TFT, Bravia Engine

Cameras.Rear camera: 5 MPx, 720p video recording @ 30 frames/s 16x Digital Zoom, autofocus, LED flash, face and smile detection, Panorama and geo-tagging

Battery.Battery: 1305 mAh, stand by time up to 520 h (2G), up to 460 h (3G), talk time up to 6 h 60 min (2G), up to 5 h 36 min (3G)

Connectivity.Connectivity: 3G HSDPA up to 14.4 Mb/s, HSUPA up to 5.76 Mb/s Wi-Fi 802.11 b/g/n with Hotspot + Wi-Fi Direct, micro-USB v2.0 with USB OTG support, DLNA
